stories.title: Debt-hit youth sells kidney, falls into crime trap:Paid ₹3.5 lakh instead of promised ₹10 lakh, seeks justice
stories.summary: Everyone has compulsions, I also had a very big compulsion. There was no source of income. In 2020-21, I used to work in Delhi, but for some reason, I left the job. I had a debt of 3 lakh rupees. Because of this, I can't even go to my village. I thought I would get 10 lakh rupees after selling my kidney. With this money, I will repay the debt, and with the remaining money, I will start a business, and set up my life.' Ayush Kumar Chaudhary, a resident of Augan village in Bhagwanpur, Begusarai district, Bihar, said these things in a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar. Ayush said that I was referred from Kanpur to Lucknow, and now I am undergoing treatment in Delhi. Actually, news had come that Ayush had sold his kidney in Kanpur out of greed for money. But when we talked to the people of Ayush's village, a different story emerged. When asked about the reason for selling his kidney, Ayush answered the reporter's questions for 4 minutes. After that, he said that he would not be able to talk for long. He was in pain. The doctor has also forbidden excessive talking. The story I have, I am sending it recorded. Ayush shared a 14-minute audio, in which he narrated his entire story. First, see two pictures of Ayush Chaudhary Now, what did Ayush reveal in the 14-minute audio? Ayush Chaudhary said that after leaving his job, he became unemployed. During this time, one day while scrolling through social media on his mobile, he came across a Telegram group. It was stated that money would be received upon completing the task. When I inquired on the number given in the group, I found the number of a boy named Ali. I talked to him. Ali told me that I would have to give him my bank account on rent. For this, I would receive money. I had asked Ali what kind of task this was, and he told me that transactions would be made from my bank account to save taxes, etc. I needed money. So, I shared my Canara Bank account number and other details with Ali. Ali gave me 20 thousand rupees for this. Actually, before receiving 20 thousand rupees, 85 thousand rupees were transferred to my account. After receiving the money, one lakh rupees were sent to my account. After this, my account was frozen. 'When I went to the bank to inquire, I found out that cyber fraud had occurred with my account' Ayush said that when my account was frozen, I did not get any information about it. Ali called me and asked - why did you freeze your account? I told Ali that I don't know anything about this. Then I went to the bank and asked for information regarding the account freeze. The bank officials told me that a cyber fraud had occurred from my account, which is why my account had been frozen. I informed Ali about this. Ali said that it might have happened by mistake, don't worry. Ayush further stated that he needed money in March. I told Ali that if there was any work suitable for me, he should let me know. I had also said that this time, he shouldn't tell me about any work that could get me or others into trouble. The work should be such that there are no problems and I also get some money. After this, Ali told me about selling a kidney. When I questioned Ali about this, he said that everything would be done according to the law. Proper paperwork would be done, and then the whole process would take place. Ali told me about Alpha Hospital in Meerut. I inquired about the hospital. After that, I thought everything would be legal; I didn't know that police verification was required. Then, swayed by Ali's words, I considered it and agreed to sell my kidney. Ali called me to Meerut. When I got off at Modipuram Bypass, I was picked up by car and taken to Alpha Hospital. At Alpha Hospital, there were people named Vaibhav and Amit, who made me sit in an upstairs room of the hospital for a while, and then arranged a room for me in a hotel in Shastri Nagar, Meerut. 'Diagnostic and MRI were done in Ghaziabad' Ayush said that the day after reaching Meerut, I was taken to Ghaziabad, where diagnostic and MRI were done. From there, I was brought back to Meerut. The next day, two individuals named Afzal and Parvez came to meet me. A patient named Parul had come to them. Afzal and Parvez took me in a Swift Dzire. When I was being taken somewhere, I had sent the car's number to a close contact on WhatsApp. After that, I deleted all this from my mobile. I used to do all this so that there would be no problem later. I was brought from Meerut to Kanpur, where I was kept for two days. Two days later, on March 21st, it was Eid, and I was told that the kidney transplant would take some time. After this, I was brought back to Meerut and stayed in a hotel. Two days later, on March 23rd, I was again brought to Kanpur. I was in a separate car, along with two other cars, which had Afzal, Parvez, Ali, Dr. Amit, and Dr. Vaibhav. The next day, March 24th, these people talked about a kidney transplant in Shamli. According to Ayush, we were brought to Dev Hospital near Shamli Gurudwara. That same day, I saw patient Parul for the first time, who was in another car. I was lodged in a hotel here for three days. On March 27, I was asked to be ready. I needed 6 thousand rupees. Afzal gave 6 thousand rupees after 4 days. This made me suspicious that if these people were taking so long to give 5-6 thousand rupees, would I get the full amount after the kidney transplant or not? But I trusted them. In the evening, I was suddenly told that the kidney transplant would happen. Amit and Ali had stayed in Kanpur. I, along with Afzal and Parvez, reached Kanpur from Shamli. I had been told in the morning not to eat, so I had a light breakfast at 8 o'clock. Asked for mobile to check account, but wasn't given Ayush said that before the operation, when I asked about the payment, I was told not to worry. I was brought to Priya Hospital with Afzal and Parvez, where I met a boy named Shivam. The patient's brother, Divyank Tomar, was here. He also told me that I would get the money. After this, I was brought to Ahuja Hospital. Late in the evening, I was given anaesthesia, which made my eyes start closing. After the kidney was removed in the operation theater, I was brought back to the hospital at 2:30 AM. In the morning, I was troubled by pain. When I woke up, I asked for my mobile to check my account balance, but I was not given the mobile. In the evening, suddenly the police came to me and gave me my phone. They had me unlock the phone. The police asked me to check my account. I didn't understand where the police had come from. When I checked the account, 3.50 lakh rupees had been deposited. But after that, the remaining 6.50 lakh rupees have not been received to date. The policeman had said at that time that he would get all the money for me, but it has not been received to date. Ayush said - Police had given assurance, but now they don't answer calls Ayush said that I told the police at that very moment that I did this work out of compulsion, then the police had said that they would get the money back, but now even the police don't answer my calls. My clothes, ATM, and bag have not been returned to me till date. There was some improvement on March 30, but I had a mild stomach ache, then I started getting a fever, so I was referred to Lucknow. I was discharged from the Lucknow hospital on April 6. Then I called the police again and told them the whole story. I had sold my kidney out of compulsion, I was saving someone's life in exchange for money, but what a mess I got into. I didn't get the money, and my kidney was also gone. We are troubled. I was offered 10 lakh for the kidney. Gujarat Cyber Police notice against Ayush SHO Neeraj Kumar Thakur of Bhagwanpur police station told a Dainik Bhaskar reporter four days ago that on Friday, April 3, they had received a notice from the Cyber Cell police of Surendranagar district, Gujarat. To serve the notice, a police team reached Ayush's house on April 4. But, Ayush's house was locked, after which the notice is being returned. The notice received from the Cyber Cell states that Ayush has carried out large-scale cyber fraud and hawala transactions through his Canara Bank account. After receiving the notice, the Cyber Cell had ordered him to appear within 15 days.

stories.title: Congress workers burn effigy of Assam chief minister in Meerut:UP chief Ajay Rai leads protests, demands apology for calling Kharge ‘Pagal’
stories.summary: Congress leaders protested in UP today and raised slogans against Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. Protesters termed Assam Chief Minister an ‘anti-Dalit’ CM. They allege CM insulted Mallikarjun Kharge, a leader from the Dalit community and the national president of the Congress party. In Meerut, Congress workers beat an effigy with slippers, then burnt it. They chanted slogans like 'Himanta Biswa Sarma Murdabad' (Down with Himanta Biswa Sarma). An effigy was burnt outside the Mathura Collectorate. In Ghaziabad, Congress leaders and workers tried to burn an effigy while protesting against the Assam Chief Minister, but the police snatched the effigy. This led to a scuffle between the workers and the police. Congress leaders allege that the police acted forcefully, even attempting to push workers down. Police had placed leaders under house arrest Before the Congress protest, the police had placed leaders under house arrest. In Varanasi, a large number of police forces arrived at the leaders' homes on Friday morning. Police are deployed outside the homes of several leaders, including the district and metropolitan presidents. UP Congress President Ajay Rai said- Sarma's use of words like Pagal (Mad) for Kharge is highly objectionable. This language shows his nervousness and frustration. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma should apologise to the entire nation. See 3 pictures- Why is the Assam CM facing opposition? The controversy began when Congress leader Pawan Khera accused the Chief Minister's wife, Riniki Bhuyan Sarma, of possessing foreign assets and multiple passports. Following this, the Assam Police raided Khera's residence in Delhi. Reacting to this action, Mallikarjun Kharge had criticised the government and called for clarification from the Ministry of External Affairs. Retaliating to this, Himanta Biswa Sarma used the word Pagal (Mad) for Kharge. Himanta said- Kharge ji is old, but he is still talking like a mad person. How can you make such accusations without knowing the truth? This is like killing someone and then talking about giving them medicine. He further added that Kharge should apologise to the country and the Assam Police would find Pawan Khera even from 'Pataal' (the underworld).

stories.title: Break on storms and rain in UP:Clear skies for 15 days; strong heat expected; mercury may cross 45 degrees, relief for farmers
stories.summary: The continuous spell of storms, rain, and hailstones in UP, ongoing for a week, is going to break from Friday. According to the Meteorological Department, the Western Disturbance is now weakening. This will lead to intense heat. The weather will remain clear for the next 15 days. There will be no rain. The mercury will jump by up to 10 °C, reaching above 45 °C. Hot winds will blow at a speed of 25 to 30 km/h. Farmers will get relief as the weather clears up. This is because the harvested wheat crops had gotten wet. The crops will dry quickly due to strong sunlight. This will enable farmers to thresh as soon as possible. The risk of crop grains turning black will be reduced. Earlier, in the last 48 hours, heavy rain accompanied by strong winds occurred in more than 50 districts. Lakhimpur Kheri recorded the highest rainfall of 15 mm. Bahraich received 6 mm, Kanpur 5.4 mm, and Lucknow 4.5 mm of rain. Jalaun was the hottest, with a temperature of 32 °C recorded. Meanwhile, Bijnor had the coldest night, where the mercury dropped to 11.5 °C. Atul Kumar Singh, a senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Centre, Lucknow, stated- From today, the effect of the Western Disturbance will end. As a result, the weather will remain dry for the next 15 days. There is no possibility of rain anywhere. The temperature may increase by approximately 10 degrees. During the day, the effect of heat and strong sunlight will be felt again. Even at night, heat will be felt. Today's weather pictures- Know the condition of the cities- How will the weather be for the next 5 days? Also, take a look at yesterday's weather pictures- What was the reason for the sudden storm and rain? The sudden storm and rain were due to a Western Disturbance. This is normal for this season. Every year, this season brings rain with storms. However, this year Western Disturbances are arriving very frequently. Because of this, the weather has remained continuously stormy and rainy. Farmers suffered losses, wheat crop in crisis Untimely rains caused heavy losses to farmers. The wheat crop was destroyed. Regarding this, CM Yogi had instructed officials to go into the field. He said that officials should survey the damage within 24 hours and compensation should be given to the affected farmers as soon as possible. No kind of negligence will be tolerated. Providing help to farmers is the government's priority.

stories.title: Deadly attack on spiritual content creator Abhinav Arora in Vrindavan:Car windows smashed, father beaten; family cries for help
stories.summary: The car of Vrindavan's spiritual content creator, Abhinav Arora, was attacked. Abhinav shared the video of the attack on his Instagram on Thursday. The attack took place in the capital, Delhi. A crowd surrounded Abhinav's car and broke its windows by hitting them with sticks. The video shows that Abhinav's family was inside the car during the attack. When the car's front window was broken, a woman screamed from inside. Abhinav's father, Tarun Raj Arora, was injured in the assault. According to him, some people alleged that a child's leg was injured by their car. This led to an argument, and soon the accused attacked them. Delhi Police has registered a case in this matter. Based on initial investigation and statements, 3 people were taken into custody. After further investigation, 2 people were sent to Tihar Jail. See 2 pictures People surrounded on the night of April 7 Tarun Raj Arora said, on the night of Tuesday, April 7, around 10 PM, I was in Tikalnagar. Suddenly, some people surrounded our car regarding a child's foot being run over by the car. They verbally abused and attacked the car. The police were immediately informed from the scene of the incident. Road Rage Case Registered As soon as the incident was reported, the police reached the spot and took swift action, registering a case of road rage. Currently, the police are investigating the entire matter and CCTV footage from the surrounding areas is being scanned to clarify all aspects of the incident. According to Tarun Raj, the police took the victim and us to the hospital. There, it was confirmed that the victim, i.e., the child, had not sustained any injuries. However, he sustained injuries during the assault. Abhinav Wrote on Social Media - You're Next Abhinav Arora shared a video of the attack on Instagram and wrote, "O those who watch a burning house, the thatched roof is yours. Behind the fire is a strong wind, ahead is your destiny. I too was silent at his murder, now my turn has come. You too are silent at my murder, you are next." Abhinav also wrote that it is inappropriate to comment on this incident by linking it to any religion or community. We deeply respect the Sikh religion. It is a symbol of courage, service, and humanity. This case is about the actions of a few individuals, not an entire religion. Who is Abhinav Arora? Abhinav Arora is the son of writer Tarun Raj. He lives in Delhi and is a 5th-grade student in a private school. 10-year-old Abhinav Arora is often seen in videos performing devotion to Lord Krishna and Ram. Abhinav has millions of followers on Instagram.

stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday highlighted the growing pressure on hospital OPDs, stating that leading institutions are witnessing an overwhelming patient load daily. At King George’s Medical University (KGMU), around 12,000 to 14,000 patients visit the OPD each day, while Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute (PGI) sees 10,000 to 11,000 patients. He noted that such high footfall makes it extremely challenging for doctors to provide effective treatment to every patient. The Chief Minister also pointed to changing lifestyles, saying excessive smartphone use is emerging as a health concern. “Using smartphones for 4 to 6 hours a day is also a kind of illness,” he remarked. Emphasising the importance of heart health, Yogi said that while a person can survive kidney failure with dialysis, a blockage in the heart can prove fatal. He was speaking at the National Interventional Council 2026, organised by the Cardiology Society of India at Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University. The Chief Minister added that Uttar Pradesh has witnessed significant expansion in healthcare services over the past nine years. Key points of CM Yogi

stories.title: 2.05 crore voters deleted from UP electoral rolls:Final SIR list released, 84 Lakh new voters added; total reaches 13.39 cr
stories.summary: The Election Commission in Uttar Pradesh released the final list of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) on Friday. The number of voters in the state has decreased by 13% to 13.39 crore. A total of 2.05 crore names have been removed from the final list, while 84 lakh new names have been added. Before the SIR, in October 2025, Uttar Pradesh had a total of 15.44 crore voters. After the first draft list was released, this number dropped to 12.55 crore, with 2.89 crore names deleted. Of those removed in the first draft, 84 lakh names have now been re-added to the list. 13.39 crore voters in the final list Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa said in a press conference that the draft voter list released on January 6 had 12,55,56,025 voters. This included 6,88,43,159 men and 5,67,08,747 women. He said that the final voter list includes 13,39,84,792 voters. Of these, male voters number 7,30,71,061 (54.54%) and female voters 6,09,09,525 (45.46%). The number of third-gender voters is 4,206. 8.15 lakh names deleted after draft list Navdeep Rinwa stated that from January 6 till now, 8,15,996 names have been removed from the voter list. Among them, 3,50,436 were due to logical errors, 3,28,350 voters were found non-existent, 79,076 names were duplicated, 55,865 people were found deceased, and 2,269 were under 18 years of age. How to check your name in the final list? He said the final voter list can be checked on voters.eci.gov.in and ceouttarpradesh.nic.in. If your name is not on the list, you can register by filling out Form-6. Applications can be submitted online at https://voters.eci.gov.in using a mobile number, and the form can also be downloaded. Final lists already released in 11 states before UP Before Uttar Pradesh, final lists had already been released in 11 states and union territories. The highest number of deletions was in Gujarat (68 lakh), followed by West Bengal (63 lakh). Understanding the full SIR process in UP The SIR process began on October 27, 2025. Enumeration started on November 4. The initial deadline to submit enumeration forms was December 4, later extended to December 11 and then December 25. The first draft roll, initially scheduled for December 31, was delayed by 15 days and published on January 6, 2026. The claims and objections period was initially until February 6, 2026, and later extended to March 6, 2026. The final list was released on April 10.

stories.title: 25 vultures found dead under suspicious circumstances in Dudhwa:Forest department starts investigation; poisoning suspected behind deaths
stories.summary: 25 rare vultures have been found dead in the buffer zone of Dudhwa Tiger Reserve in Lakhimpur Kheri, raising serious concern among the forest department and wildlife enthusiasts. Initial investigation suggests that poisoning may be the cause of death. These vultures were found dead under suspicious circumstances near Simariya village in the Bhira range three days ago. The deceased birds belonged to three different species. The Dudhwa region is known to host six out of the nine vulture species found in India—Indian, White-rumped, Slender-billed, Himalayan, Cinereous, and Eurasian Griffon. In recent years, their population in the area had increased to around 250, making it an important site for vulture conservation. Considering the seriousness of the incident, APCCF Wildlife Ram Kumar inspected the site. An investigation has been initiated in coordination with DFO Kirti Chaudhary. The forest department has registered a case against unknown persons under the Wildlife Protection Act. However, no accused has been identified or arrested so far.

stories.title: Auto driver among 11 held for raping Gorakhpur minor girl:Class 9 student recounts ordeal that lasted for 4 months
stories.summary: 'Auto driver Mukesh deceived me with the promise of marriage. He applied sindoor in my maang (hair parting). He would take me to hotels as his wife. He would stay there for 4-4 hours and have physical relations with me. Manvendra, who was doing an MBA, took me to his room. He told the landlord that his younger sister had come. At night, he had physical relations with me. He told me don't worry, everything will be fine. I will marry you and fulfill all your desires. I stayed with him in a rented room for 1 month. After that, he left me on the street and went somewhere. I didn't listen to my family members; perhaps that's why I have to face all this today.' Says, a 9th-grade student in Gorakhpur, and she broke down crying. The 14-year-old girl alleges that 10 people have committed atrocities against her in 4 months. Police have arrested 11 people in this case. Know how a girl got trapped while dreaming of living a high-profile life... Mother is sick, maternal uncle took responsibility for teaching Police investigation has revealed that the student's mother is mentally ill. Her father works as a laborer in Gujarat. Due to the poor financial condition of the family, the student was taken to their home by her maternal aunt and uncle, who live in the Chauri-Chaura area. The maternal uncle had taken responsibility for teaching the student. She was admitted to the 9th class in a nearby inter-college. But the student, who was fond of making reels, wanted to live a high-profile life. She wanted to become rich through shortcuts. While going to and from school, she became acquainted with auto driver Monu alias Manish. Monu started joking and chatting with the student. He would also drop her off at school while coming and going. They also started talking on mobile. On the morning of November 1, the student left her aunt's house for school around 9 AM. On the way, she met auto driver Manish Rajbhar, alias Monu. Monu made her sit in the auto and took her to a house under construction. Where he had physical relations with her. Meanwhile, his two friends Kishan Singh and Sameer alias Dilshad, who is a chicken butcher, also arrived. Both of them also had physical relations with the student one-on-one. After this, the student was dropped off on the road. MBA student committed brutality by making her his sister The student told the police that after all this happened to me, I didn't understand how to go home. I caught an auto and went to Ramgarhtal. I was sitting there. Then I met a young man. He came and started talking to me. I told him about my problem. He told his name as Manvendra Pandey. Manvendra is a resident of the Rudrapur police station area in Deoria. He has taken a rented room near the Engineering College and is studying MBA. Manvendra took me into confidence and took me to his room. There, he told the landlord that my younger sister had come. At night, he had physical relations with me. I was very scared. I couldn't even speak. He said that don't worry, everything will be fine. I will marry you and fulfill all your wishes. This way, I stayed with him in a rented room for 1 month. After that, he left me on the street and went somewhere. He never came back. Husband raped, wife pressures for wrong business The student was wandering here and there on the street. During this time, she met a married man, Rohit Sahni, who lives in Rustampur. Rohit took the student to his house after gaining her trust. There, he introduced her to his wife, Nisha Chauhan. The student said that here too, Rohit Sahni started raping her from the second day itself. Meanwhile, his wife, Nisha, would pressure her to do wrong work. Nisha Chauhan had forced her to sleep with some people by pressuring her. When I somehow escaped from there, I met auto driver Mukesh Gaud near Phuthwa Inar. Mukesh kept me with him and deceived me with the promise of marriage. He filled my hairline with vermillion. After this, he would take me as his wife to a hotel in the Chauri Chaura area. He would stay there for 4-4 hours and have physical relations with me. Thus, wherever I went, only wrong happened to me. No one took pity on me. Now I am worried thinking about my future. After all this has happened, who will accept me? 11 accused arrested, more names may emerge Chauri Chaura police arrested Madhuban Hotel operator Dharmaraj Yadav, Kishan Singh, Sameer alias Dilshad, and Manish Rajbhar alias Monu on Wednesday and sent them to jail. In continuation of this, on Thursday, police arrested Manvendra Pandey, an MBA student from Rudrapur Deoria, Rohit Sahni, a resident of Rustampur in Ramgarh Taal, Rohit's wife Nisha Chauhan, Akash Gaud from Chauri Chaura, Harmendra Jaiswal, and restaurant operator Ajay Nishad, and arrested Neetu alias Riya Shukla on charges of providing shelter and sent them to jail. According to the police, the investigation of this case is ongoing. More names may emerge in the future. Several important clues were found from husband-wife's mobile phones The police have found several important clues from the mobile phones of Rohit and Nisha. Based on these, the involvement of other accused may also come to light. The police say that as the investigation progresses, new facts and links are being discovered. Investigation is ongoing based on the important clues found in the mobile phones. In this regard, SP North Gyanendra Kumar said- Action has been taken against 11 accused. Investigation is underway, and based on evidence, whoever's names come forward will also face action. According to police, on November 1, 2025, the student left home at 9 AM to go to school. The auto driver took her to an under-construction house. He raped her there. A short while later, Manish's friends Sameer, alias Dilshad, and Kishan, alias Bittu, also arrived. Both of them also raped her. When the student did not return home after the incident, family members searched extensively in the area. On November 7, they filed a complaint at the police station. stories.title: Justice Varma resigns from Allahabad HC:Bags of cash recovered from official residence a year ago; kept off judicial duties since then
stories.summary: Justice Yashwant Varma of the Allahabad High Court has submitted his resignation to the President.The development comes in the backdrop of allegations that bundles of ₹500 notes were found burnt during a fire at his official residence in Delhi on 14 March 2025. Following the incident, Justice Varma was transferred from the Delhi High Court to the Allahabad High Court. He was sworn in on 5 April 2025 but was not assigned judicial duties and remained barred from judicial work pending an inquiry. Justice Varma later challenged the impeachment proceedings initiated against him, arguing that the motion was not properly approved by both Houses of Parliament. While the proposal was introduced in both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, it was not cleared by the Upper House, according to the petition. Despite this, a committee was constituted by the Lok Sabha to examine the allegations. | Assam records historic 85.91% voter turnout, Puducherry close to 90% On 6 January, the Supreme Court noted apparent flaws in the composition of the parliamentary inquiry committee and said it would examine whether the defects were serious enough to invalidate the proceedings. The court reserved its decision on 8 January after a two-day hearing. A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Satish Chandra Sharma declined to grant Justice Varma additional time to file a response before the parliamentary panel. SC flags flaws in parliamentary inquiry panel On 7 January, the Spureme Court observed shortcomings in the inquiry panel constituted by the Lok Sabha Speaker, while also noting that under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, the Speaker is empowered to set up such a committee even if a similar proposal is not approved in the Rajya Sabha. SC notice to Lok Sabha Speaker: 16 Dec 2025 Earlier, on 16 December 2025, the Supreme Court issued notices to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and sought responses from the secretaries general of both Houses. The bench questioned aspects of the committee’s formation during the hearing. | UK man fined ₹1.8 lakh for calling colleague ‘aunty’ Justice Varma also filed a separate petition challenging proceedings under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968, after the Supreme Court earlier dismissed a related plea. The petition contends that the inquiry panel constituted by the Lok Sabha Speaker under Section 3(2) of the Act is unconstitutional and seeks to quash the 12 August 2025 order. ‘Inquiry panel unconstitutional’ On 7 August, the Supreme Court dismissed a petition challenging the report of an internal committee and the recommendation of Chief Justice Khanna. Following this, Justice Varma filed a fresh petition challenging proceedings initiated under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968. The petition argues that the inquiry panel constituted by the Lok Sabha Speaker under Section 3(2) of the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968 is unconstitutional. It seeks to declare the Speaker’s action of 12 August 2025 invalid and set it aside. Counsel for Justice Varma submitted that before initiating removal proceedings against a judge, both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha should jointly constitute an inquiry committee, and the Speaker of the Lok Sabha should not act unilaterally. Earlier, a three-judge committee of High Court judges had found Justice Varma guilty and recommended his removal. Following this, the government introduced an impeachment motion in Parliament, which was approved by the Speaker with the support of 146 Members of Parliament.

stories.title: 22 witnesses identify Meerut blue drum murder accused:Muskan and lover Sahil to be sentenced for husband’s murder
stories.summary: Saurabh Rajput, who worked in London, returned to Meerut to celebrate his wife Muskan's birthday. However, Muskan, along with her lover Sahil Shukla, conspired to murder him. On March 3, 2025, Muskan drugged Saurabh's dinner, and after he fell asleep, Sahil was called over. Together, they stabbed Saurabh to death, dismembered his body into four pieces, and hid the remains in a blue plastic drum filled with cement. Muskan then took their daughter to her mother's house and went on a trip to Shimla and Manali with Sahil, using Saurabh's phone to maintain the illusion that he was still alive. They ran out of money and returned to Meerut, where the crime was eventually discovered. Both Muskan and Sahil were arrested. The trial is ongoing, with all 22 witnesses testifying against them. Now know who said what Rahul aka Babloo (Saurabh's Brother): "My brother's murder was committed by Muskan and Sahil. Saurabh and I weren't in contact. We were worried why I wasn't talking to my brother? On March 17, someone told me that my brother's body was lying in his house. When I went there, there was a dead body, which was my younger brother Saurabh's. My brother's wife, Muskan, and her lover, Sahil, committed the murder." Police Officer (Name not specified): "I wrote the complaint in this case. It was stated that a body was found in a blue drum in a house in Brahmapuri. Later, I had the complaint written by Rahul, the brother of the deceased Saurabh. In this, it came to light that a woman named Muskan, along with her lover Sahil, had murdered her husband Saurabh. After the murder, the body was hidden in a blue drum." Mother of Saurabh (Name not specified): "My younger son Saurabh fell in love with Muskan Rastogi, who lived in the neighborhood. Despite our repeated refusals, Saurabh married Muskan. After marriage, when Muskan lived with us in her in-laws' house, her attitude was very bad. She did not take care of Saurabh at all. She used to fight with our whole family. Even before the marriage, Muskan used to meet Sahil. When Saurabh went to London, Muskan and Sahil used to meet often. Once Muskan left home quietly and went somewhere with her lover, Sahil. Later, he was searched with the help of the police. Even then, Saurabh had asked Muskan to stay away from Sahil. But, she did not agree. Muskan, along with her lover Sahil, killed my son." Neighbor (Name not specified): "I live in Brahmapuri. I know Saurabh. My house is also on the same street. I had seen Sahil, who lived in the street ahead, going to Saurabh's house at night on March 3. Saurabh and Muskan were at home that day. Sahil also went to Muskan's house at night. On March 17, we came to know that Sahil-Muskan had murdered Saurabh together. His dead body was found in a blue drum in the same house. A lot of police had also come there." Shopkeeper (Knife Shop): "A girl came to me to buy a knife. She told me that she needed a knife to cut vegetables and fruits. Later, when the girl's photo was printed in the newspaper, it was written that her name is Muskan. She has murdered her husband along with her lover. When I saw that photo, I recognized the girl. This was the same girl who had bought a knife and razor from my shop a few days ago." Shopkeeper (Drum Shop): "I have a plastic drum selling shop near Ghantaghar. These drums are specially taken by people for storing ration in the house. Apart from this, these drums are used for keeping milk and goods in homes. Muskan-Sahil had come to me to buy a drum. He told me that he needed a big drum to keep wheat. He liked a blue plastic drum of 1200 liters. Both of them bought and took with them in an e-rickshaw. I had sold them this drum. When I saw in the media channels that a woman in Brahmapuri had murdered her husband along with her lover and disposed of the dead body in a blue drum. When I saw his picture, I remembered that these are the same boy and girl who had bought a blue drum from my place." Shopkeeper (Cement Shop): "I have a shop selling sand and cement on Sharda Road. A boy and a girl had come to my place in an e-rickshaw. He bought 1 bag of sand and 2 bags of cement from me. Took it in a rickshaw. I didn't know why these people were taking cement and sand. Like a normal customer, I had sold them cement and sand, the details of which I also have. Later, when I saw the news of Saurabh's murder on the media, I recognized the girl and the boy. It was Muskan-Sahil who had taken cement and sand from my shop." Doctor (Name not specified): "Muskan had come to me for a checkup. She told me that she had a fever, and she was not feeling well. She was feeling very weak. Then I wrote a prescription on my slip for her. In this, I had written medicines for fever and headache. I had said that if you take this medicine, your health will be fine. That was my slip. But, I had not written the drug Mizolam anywhere in my slip. The medicines that Muskan bought from the medicine shop, I had not written those medicines. I had written only medicines for fever and weakness on my slip for Muskan." Pharmacist (Name not specified): "I have a very old medicine shop in Khairnagar. A girl came to our shop on a scooty with an elderly person. That old man was standing on the scooty outside the shop. The girl came inside the shop. She showed me a prescription from Dr. Arvind Kumar Deshwal. Some other medicines, including Mizolam, were written on this slip of the doctor. These were medicines for anxiety and neuro. We do not give neuro medicines without a doctor's prescription. But, the girl had these medicines written on the doctor's slip. The girl showed me that slip on her mobile. After seeing the doctor's slip, I gave those medicines, Mizolam, to that girl. Giving money, that girl returned to the same old man on the scooty. Later, it was learned through the media that a boy named Saurabh had been murdered by his wife. When I saw that girl's face in the paper, it was the same girl who had bought medicine from my shop. Her name was Muskan, which was confirmed to me online." Laborer (Name not specified): "I was called by giving information from Brahmapuri police station. The policemen took me to the mortuary of the medical hospital. Where I was shown a blue colored drum. Said, cut it. First, I tried to open the drum from the top lid side - it did not open. The lid was jammed. The drum was very heavy. I don't know what was filled in it. After this, I tried to cut the drum from the lid side, but it was not cut. Then I started cutting the drum lengthwise. I had cut a blue drum in the presence of the police. As soon as the drum was cut, a lot of frozen cement came out from inside it. 2 pillow covers came out in the cement. There was a dead, headless body. Two wrists also came out. Along with it, a razor and a knife also came out. This dead body was of the same boy, Saurabh, whom his wife Muskan had killed along with her lover Sahil. I had read this in the newspaper." Police Officer (Name not specified): "A case of murder of a youth named Saurabh had come to light in Brahmapuri police station area. The cement-laden dead body of a youth was found inside a blue plastic drum. The drum was cut by the laborer. Inside, the dead body of Saurabh was found in 3 pieces. The wrist and head of the dead body were separate. Due to being continuously buried in cement, the dead body had turned white from place to place. I had filled his Panchnama." Doctor (Postmortem): "A dead body of a boy named Saurabh had come out from inside the blue drum. I had done his postmortem. The hands of the dead body were separate from the wrist and body. The head was also kept separately, cut off. There was a torso on one side. Saurabh's body, on the chest, on the right side, above the nipple, was stabbed 3 times with a knife. There were marks of it. A narcotic substance (some food) was found in his body. Which was eaten before dying. There were marks of sharp weapons at many places on the body. He was murdered very brutally." Cab Driver (Name not specified): "Muskan and Sahil both went to Kasol, Manali, Mussoorie from Delhi Road in Meerut in my cab. I had got this booking from my company itself. I didn't know who Muskan-Sahil both are? Both of them used to roam with me in the cab. Both of them used to treat each other like husband and wife. Both of them had also drunk alcohol during the journey. I didn't know that these two had murdered Saurabh and had come to roam with me. I had dropped them back in Meerut. After this, on March 19, I read the news of Saurabh's murder in the newspaper. Muskan-Sahil's picture was put up, then I came to know that these two are the same people who had roamed in my cab for the last 10 days. They were also talking about going for a walk again." Police Officer (Name not specified): "On information about finding a dead body in a house in Brahmapuri police station area, our teams went to the spot. It was found that the dead body was hidden in a blue plastic drum. After this, the teams investigated there. Later, it was found that a girl named Muskan had murdered her husband, Saurabh, along with her lover, Sahil. The dead body was hidden in the drum." Police Officer (Call Detail Records): "Call details of some numbers were sought from us by the police. We had given the report of this call detail and mobile location. This conversation is between Muskan and Sahil. Along with this, Saurabh's call details are also included in it." Forensic Expert (Name not specified): "A dead body was found in a blue drum in a house in Brahmapuri. After this our team reached the spot. The team had taken blood samples from there. Blood stains were from the walls of the room to the ceiling. A blue colored suitcase was also found in the room, in which there was blood. There was also blood on the sheet and mattress on the bed." Hotel Staff (Multiple): "Muskan and Sahil both had come and stayed at our hotel. Both had told each other husband and wife. Aadhar card was also submitted. Only after that did they stay. Both of them had told us that they are husband and wife." Childhood Friend of Saurabh (Name not specified): "Saurabh was my childhood friend. We had studied together in the same school till the 10th class. I came to know that Saurabh has come to India from London, so I wanted to meet and talk to him. I was constantly calling Saurabh, but I was not able to talk to him. Then on March 8, 2025, I called Saurabh's number again. His wife Muskan received the phone. As soon as Muskan picked up the phone, she said don't disturb us. Saurabh is busy, so we have come out for a walk. You are disturbing us again and again by calling us. She also abused me. She did not let me talk to Saurabh." Now know the complete matter February 25, 2025, was Muskan's birthday. Exactly one day before, on February 24, Saurabh came to Meerut to celebrate his birthday. After Saurabh's return, Sahil started getting worried. It was decided that on March 4, Saurabh had to be removed from the way. Muskan first put Peehu to sleep in the room next to the bedroom. That night, she mixed sedative medicine in the dinner. Saurabh fell asleep quickly after eating. After this, Muskan called Sahil. After Sahil arrived, Muskan stabbed a knife into Saurabh's chest. After Saurabh's death, his body was dragged to the bathroom. Muskan and Sahil together cut the body into 4 pieces. To hide them, they brought a large plastic drum for storing water from the market. The pieces of the body were filled in this drum. Both stayed in the lobby all night with the body Muskan and Sahil knew that after decomposing, the body would emit a foul smell. Therefore, they poured water over the body and filled it with cement. After this, both of them stayed together in the same lobby all night. On the morning of March 5, 2025, Muskan woke up Pihu. She took Pihu to her mother, Kavita's, house, and dropped her off. Then she came back and went to visit Shimla-Manali with Sahil. Muskan had taken Saurabh's mobile with her. She kept operating Saurabh's WhatsApp from there. Sahil told the police that we both got married at a temple in Shimla. But our money was running out on hotel, food, drink, and sightseeing. There were ₹6 lakh in Saurabh's bank account. Muskan was unable to withdraw that money. At mother Kavita's insistence, on March 17, Muskan returned to Meerut with Sahil. After this, the entire matter kept unfolding.

stories.title: SC calls, 'Meerut case a warning for the nation':Says business can't run at cost of lives; orders demolition of 859 properties
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has taken a strict stance against illegal construction in Meerut. The court on Thursday ordered the demolition of illegal setbacks on 859 properties within two months. An illegal setback means construction done in the mandatory open space that must be left around a building. According to Live Law, the court said- The matter is not limited to UP alone, but is a warning for the country. If the administration had taken steps in time, such a big problem would not have arisen. The rule of law cannot bow down to people's noise and clamor. Business cannot run at the cost of someone's life. The court reprimanded UP officials. It questioned how permission was given to run schools, hospitals, and even government banks from such buildings that are completely illegal and unauthorized. In the case, on April 6, the court had ordered the sealing of 44 properties in Central Market out of 859 properties and sought a report. On Wednesday, the Housing Development Council sealed all 44 shops. The administration informed the court that 44 properties have been sealed. However, during the sealing, officers had to face opposition from traders. The next hearing in the case will now be held in July. 'Setback cannot be legitimized in any way' On Thursday, the case was heard by the bench of Justice JB Pardiwala and Justice KV Viswanathan. Lawyer Rajiv Shakdhar, appearing on behalf of UP Housing and Development Council in the court, informed that among the 44 sealed properties, there are 6 schools, 6 hospitals, 4 banquet halls, 3 banks, and one non-banking financial company. The bench expressed strong displeasure at this. The court questioned who gave permission to these institutions. It said that the most important thing for us is the lives of innocent children, common people, and patients. We have nothing to do with your business. You are doing your business at the cost of someone's life. A setback cannot be legitimized in any way. No person can justify this illegal occupation by paying a fine or fee. Rules will be strictly enforced. 'Administration should recover demolition costs from encroachers' The bench clarified the process of demolishing illegal constructions. The court told the authorities that notice will be given first to remove illegal constructions. The encroachers will be given 10 to 15 days to remove the illegal portion themselves. If they do not do so, the administration will carry out the demolition itself. Its cost will be recovered from the encroachers. 'Illegal constructions increased due to negligence; stopping them is necessary' The court said that Illegal constructions have grown to such a large scale only due to the negligence of the administration. Now, strict action is necessary to stop this. The court directed the Housing and Development Council to file an affidavit on the status of 44 properties. This should include before and after photographs of sealing each property, so that it is clear that the action has been taken properly.

stories.title: PM to visit Daat Kali Temple after Delhi-Dehradun Expressway inauguration:14-km roadshow planned; venue to be decorated with 100 Kg flowers
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will perform special worship for about 15 minutes at Siddhpeeth Daat Kali Temple during his Uttarakhand visit on April 14. The temple is being decorated with marigolds, roses, and jasmine flowers brought from Vrindavan and West Bengal. The special thing is that after inaugurating the Dehradun-Delhi Expressway, the Prime Minister will visit the temple to seek blessings, which has a history connected to road and tunnel construction. According to the temple management, special worship has been organised for the Prime Minister, which normally takes 5 to 10 minutes, but due to security and protocol, this time may extend to 15 minutes. However, the exact time of his arrival has not been fixed yet. The temple is being decorated with flowers brought from Vrindavan and West Bengal. A total of 100 kg of flowers is being used. Tunnel on Dehradun-Delhi route used to collapse repeatedly The history of the Daat Kali Temple is deeply connected with road and tunnel construction. Shubham Goswami, associated with the temple management, explains that in 1804, when the Dehradun-Delhi route was being built, the tunnel here used to collapse repeatedly. Later, the Pindi of the Mother Goddess was removed and installed here, after which the construction work was completed successfully. Since then, it has been called 'Daat Kali', because in the local language, a tunnel is called 'Daat'. Regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's proposed visit, he informed that there is information about the Prime Minister's visit on April 14, and special worship arrangements have been made for him. Will reach temple after inauguration of Green Corridor The Prime Minister will arrive at Ganeshpur in Saharanpur by MI-17 helicopter, where he will inaugurate Asia's largest Green Elevated Corridor. During this, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, along with several ministers, MPs and MLAs, will be present. Administrative preparations have been intensified from Ganeshpur to Dehradun for the program. After the inauguration, the Prime Minister will travel on the same expressway and reach the Daat Kali Temple located on the Uttarakhand-UP border. After worship here, he will leave by road for Mahindra Ground in Dehradun, where a road show-like atmosphere will be seen on GMS Road and the Garhi Cantt area. Dhami says, 'There is enthusiasm in the state regarding PM Modi's visit' Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said that there is enthusiasm in the state regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's proposed visit to Dehradun on April 14, and several development projects may also be dedicated to the public during this time. He said that the Prime Minister has a special and spiritual attachment to Uttarakhand. During his tenure, the development of border areas has gained new momentum. Whether it is giving Mana the status of 'First Village', or reaching remote areas like Mukhba, Harsil and Adi Kailash to promote development and tourism. This reflects his connection with Uttarakhand. Even during times of disaster, he came among the people of Uttarakhand and boosted their morale. On the occasion of the state completing 25 years, he also participated. This time again, regarding his visit, we welcome and felicitate him. Grand public meeting to be held at mahindra ground The Prime Minister will address a public meeting organised at Mahindra Ground in Dehradun, where approximately one lakh people are expected to participate. The BJP organisation and administration are engaged in preparations at different levels for the event. Along with the inauguration of the expressway, the Prime Minister will also gift Uttarakhand several development projects. During this time, foundation stone laying and announcements of schemes worth crores of rupees are likely to take place. BJP State President said that road show will be 12-13 km long BJP has intensified preparations for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Uttarakhand visit. State President Mahendra Bhatt said that the people of Devbhumi are very excited to welcome the Prime Minister and the organization and the common people are fully engaged to make the program successful. He informed, The Prime Minister's road show will be approximately 12 to 13 kms long, in which thousands of people will participate. After this, a massive public meeting will be organized, which will be attended by people from different parts of the state.Bhatt also said that the Prime Minister has a special connection with Uttarakhand and his visit reflects the central government's commitment to the state's development. Responsibilities have been assigned to officials at the organizational level and special attention is being paid to security arrangements along with the grandeur of the program. The journey will be completed in two and a half hours via Delhi-Dehradun Expressway.12 km long Green Elevated Corridor will be the special attraction.The biggest feature of the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway is its 12-km long Green Elevated Corridor which passes through Rajaji National Park.Modern technology has been used on the highway. CCTV cameras and solar lights have been installed at various places, which will ensure security and better lighting even at night. This will enable journeys of over 200 kms to be completed in just a few hours.

stories.title: Rajbhar says, 'Will contest all 10 Atraulia seats':Sanjay Nishad warns of independent run if denied ticket; rift deepens
stories.summary: The chiefs of SBSP and Nishad Party, who are part of the UP government, have come face-to-face. The matter is related to the Atraulia assembly seat in Azamgarh. SBSP chief Om Prakash Rajbhar, who reached Azamgarh on Thursday, said that his party will contest elections on all 10 seats here. Preparations are underway for this. Azamgarh is not anyone's stronghold. People of all castes and religions live here. Among the 10 seats that Rajbhar mentioned, the Atraulia seat is also included, from where the Nishad Party had contested in the 2022 assembly elections. Expressing displeasure over Rajbhar's statement, Sanjay Nishad hit back. In Varanasi, Sanjay Nishad said- The distribution of seats has not happened yet. Nor, has there been any discussion regarding any seat. Still, Om Prakash Rajbhar talked about contesting from the Atraulia seat, which is not right. Talking about contesting from here is completely irresponsible. First, know what Sanjay Nishad said Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad said that the Atraulia seat is a Nishad community-dominated seat. Nishad Party has the first claim here. In the last assembly elections, the Nishad candidate was the runner-up, losing by a few votes. In this election, a Nishad candidate will definitely contest. If I don't get the seat in the alliance, then our candidate will contest as an independent or from the Nishad Party. Sanjay Nishad said that Om Prakash Rajbhar has made an announcement without any discussion, so he should know about it. We are people who stay within decorum. He did not respect the decorum. He should have talked. If we also start making such announcements in his seat, would he like it? BJP is like an elder brother to us Sanjay Nishad said that the BJP is like an elder brother to us. We always work according to its advice. This is the rule of alliance that we do not give any opinion without consensus. By the way, whatever political advice the BJP has given us till date has been completely beneficial for us. Should see which community has more population there Sanjay Nishad said that if Rajbhar really wants to contest elections from the Atraulia seat in Azamgarh, then he should definitely talk about this matter. It should also be seen which community has the largest population there? In the entire state, voters from the Nishad community are in a decisive role in 80 seats. In such a situation, whichever seats the BJP makes us contest from, we will win from there. In the last election, there were some seats where the margin of our defeat or victory was quite small. Rajbhar's statement is completely irresponsible Sanjay Nishad said that in the 2022 election, the Atrauli seat was given to our party in alliance with the BJP. From here, we made Prashant Singh our candidate. However, he lost to SP's Sangram Yadav. He came second. Even after this defeat, Prashant Singh has worked to strengthen the Nishad Party in the area. In such a situation, Rajbhar's talk of contesting from here is completely irresponsible. Now read what Rajbhar said in Azamgarh Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party chief and Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar now has his eyes on Azamgarh. That's why he has been continuously visiting Azamgarh for the last 3 months. On Thursday, Rajbhar said in Azamgarh, the Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party will contest elections on all 10 seats here. We will also contest from the Jahurabad assembly seat in Ghazipur. This time we will win the election by more than 40 thousand votes. When riots were happening in Muzaffarnagar, Akhilesh was watching dance performances Dainik Bhaskar - In a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, Omprakash Rajbhar took a jibe at SP chief Akhilesh Yadav over his statements on the kidney scam and the Dhurandhar film. He said that he talks about Codeine Bhaiya, Kaleen Bhaiya. He doesn't talk about implementing the Rohini Commission report. He won't talk about implementing a 27 percent reservation. He won't talk about getting a share for the backwards. Instead, he makes absurd statements. Rajbhar said that Akhilesh Yadav should explain that when riots were happening in Muzaffarnagar, he was watching dance performances in Saifai. Riots used to happen during the SP government. Curfews were imposed. Now it's Yogi Adityanath's government. No riots have occurred. Everything is fine in UP. We are preparing for elections. I have asked all workers to get engaged in strengthening the party organisation. All our workers are rapidly engaged in preparations. Now know the equation of Atraulia seat SP MLA Sangram Yadav has been continuously winning from the Atraulia seat since 2012. His father, Balram Yadav, has also been an MLA from this seat 4 times. He has also held a ministerial position in the SP government. If we look at the figures, so far from the Atraulia seat, Congress candidates have won once, and BSP candidates have won elections twice. In the 2017 assembly elections, despite the Modi wave, SP's Sangram Yadav won the seat. Speaking of caste-based voters, Dalit and upper caste voters play a crucial role in victory. Here, Yadavs number between 60 to 70 thousand, and Muslims are between 40 to 50 thousand. Rajbhars and Nishads are between 60 to 70 thousand. Apart from this, Dalits (Jatav, Pasi) are between 40 to 50 thousand. Brahmin voters are 20 to 30 thousand, Kshatriyas 20 to 25 thousand, Vaishya/Baniya also around 25 thousand, and other smaller castes are between 20 to 30 thousand. In such a situation, whichever side the upper caste and Dalit votes go to, the victory almost always goes to that party's candidate. Along with the Yadav and Muslim factor, Sangram Yadav has been winning continuously due to development works.

stories.title: Varanasi’s first urban ropeway nears launch:4 km journey to take 15 mins, fares likely ₹50
stories.summary: In the country, the ropeway has been used only for commuting in the mountains so far. However, the ropeway will also be used to travel over the narrow lanes of Varanasi. The country's first and the world's third urban transport ropeway project is almost ready in Varanasi. With this, the distance of about 4 km from Varanasi Cantt to Godaulia Chowk can be covered in just 15 minutes. Currently, it takes 1 hour due to traffic. With the launch of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's dream project, there will be significant savings in time and fuel. This project, worth about ₹815 crore, is not only a new means of transport, but also a unique blend of the city's heritage and modernity. Read this report related to the ropeway project… 90 percent work completed, inauguration by November Out of 5 stations from Varanasi Cantt to Godaulia Chowk, 3 stations (Cantt, Vidyapeeth and Rathyatra) are ready. Work at Girjaghar and Godaulia Chowk is in the final stage. These stations are being built on the lines of metro stations. Facilities like commercial space, budget hotels, and restaurants will also be available here. At the stations where work has been completed, load testing of the ropeway has also been almost completed. This is why cable cars can be seen running on a rope, pulled with the support of towers 40 to 150 feet high in densely populated areas. In load testing, cable cars are being run empty first and then with a weight. For weight, 800 kg heavy sandbags are placed in the cable cars. In the full-speed trial run, the cable cars are being operated at a speed of 6 m/s, which is approximately 21 km/hour. Each time, three cable cars are run to check their motors, cables, control systems, braking, speed and safety. Safety and security checking under the supervision of experts from Switzerland and Austria is still pending. After all the work is completed, preparations are being made to have Prime Minister Modi inaugurate the ropeway around Dev-Deepawali in November. Fare could be between ₹30 to 50 According to Manoj Kumar, PRO of National Highway Logistics Management Limited (NHLML), the plan is to keep the fare at ₹30 from Cantt Ropeway Station to Vidyapeeth, ₹40 to Rathyatra, and ₹50 to Godaulia. Once the ropeway is fully ready, people will get relief from the traffic jams in the old lanes of Kashi Vishwanath Temple and Dashashwamedh Ghat. Currently, it takes about an hour to reach Godaulia Chowk from Varanasi Cantt. With the ropeway, it will take only 15 minutes. It will take just 6.5 minutes to reach Rathyatra from Cantt. The entire rope-way project is supported on a total of 30 towers. At different locations, their height ranges from 40 to 150 feet. A total of 148 cable cars will run between these towers. Each cable car can seat 10 people at a time. This way, a total of 1480 people can travel at once. In this manner, with 10 trolleys, approximately 6 thousand people can travel in an hour. The plan is to operate the rope-way for 16 hours a day. According to this, 90 thousand to 1 lakh people can travel. The company building the rope-way, NHLML and Vishwa Samudra Engineering (VSE), have been given the responsibility of its operation and maintenance for 15 years. 3-layer safety in rope-way, sensors on every tower Thousands of passengers will travel on this ropeway daily. Therefore, a 3-layer safety arrangement has been made. Sensors have been installed on all 30 towers, which will continuously transmit data about the pressure on the towers every moment. The ropeway corridor will be connected to a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system. Through this, 24-hour real-time monitoring and controlling of the ropeway will be possible via software and hardware. Switzerland's Bartholet Maschinenbau AG technology has been used in the design of the ropeway. Meanwhile, the cable cars have been designed by Germany's Porsche Design Studio. 24-hour medical and ambulance facilities will also be available at all five ropeway stations. Additionally, one crane each will be stationed at all five stations. In case of any emergency situation, passengers can be safely evacuated from the cable cars using the cranes. Currently, rope-ways in the country are only in hilly areas The Kashi Rope-way Project is not just a new mode of transport, but also a unique blend of the city's heritage and modernity. While travelling on the rope-way, people will get to see the beautiful view of the Kashi Vishwanath Temple and the city. This project will include Varanasi among India's cities with the most modern transport. Currently, rope-ways are used only for commuting in hilly areas. In UP, ropeway facilities are available only at religious places like Vindhyachal, Radharani Temple in Barsana, Hanuman Dhara in Chitrakoot, and Lakshman Pahari. For the first time in Varanasi, such a rope-way is being built to pass over the narrow lanes of the city. This will not only provide relief from traffic jams, but will also reduce pollution. Along with this, fuel and people's time will also be saved.

stories.summary: A tragic incident unfolded in North Dinajpur as an elderly woman died during a dispute over voting procedures.
