Serena Williams posts rare family Easter photos with Alexis Ohanian, Olympia and Adira and reveals why motherhood changed her life
stories.summary: Serena Williams shared rare Easter photos with Alexis Ohanian and daughters Olympia and Adira, calling family time everything. She also spoke on Today about motherhood, her daughters’ personalities, and learning to balance attention between them. Her words and photos showed a simple, honest side of life after tennis, focused fully on family and everyday moments.

stories.title: “This is why content is so boring”: Streamer Rasmr backs Rakai in MrBeast controversy
stories.summary: Online fans debated Rakai's aggressive gameplay in MrBeast's challenge. Streamer Rasmr defended Rakai, calling him a brave villain. Rasmr believes content is too safe today and Rakai's actions made the video exciting. While some viewers criticized Rakai, supporters see his bold play as refreshing. Rakai's role sparked discussion about creator boldness.

stories.title: Assam police team lands at Pawan Khera's Delhi home but doesn't find him; he has fled to Hyderabad, says Himanta Sarma
stories.summary: Assam Police searched Congress leader Pawan Khera's Delhi residence in connection with a case filed by Assam CM's wife over alleged multiple passports and foreign assets. Khera was not found, and electronic devices were seized. The BJP defended the action, while Congress termed it a 'witch hunt' and a 'bully' tactic.

stories.title: CM vs CM: Pinarayi-Revanth slugfest on last campaign day
stories.summary: Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan and Telangana CM Revanth Reddy engaged in a heated exchange of words during election campaigning. Vijayan responded to Reddy's earlier remarks with a jibe, which Reddy then likened to PM Modi's rhetoric, accusing Vijayan of 'devil's rule' and having BJP support. Vijayan later attempted to de-escalate by sending Reddy a letter detailing Kerala's development achievements.

IShowSpeed set for WWE debut at WrestleMania 42 in six-man tag match
stories.summary: IShowSpeed is set to make his WWE in-ring debut at WrestleMania 42 on April 18-19, 2026, teaming with Logan Paul and Austin Theory against The Usos and LA Knight. Despite prior WWE appearances and viral moments, this marks his first official match. The storyline also involves a potential continuation of Danhausen's "curse" impacting Speed during the bout.

stories.title: History books can’t prove title, says Jammu & Kashmir HC; declares two shrines & attached properties in Kishtwar as waqf
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir High Court has ruled two Kishtwar shrines and their properties as waqf, denying ownership rights to petitioners claiming hereditary custodianship. The court emphasized that property titles must be based on evidence, not public history, dismissing reliance on historical texts for ownership claims.

stories.title: New Jersey Devils head coach Sheldon Keefe faces uncertainty over his future following GM Tom Fitzgerald's departure
stories.summary: The New Jersey Devils are in flux after General Manager Tom Fitzgerald's departure, casting a shadow over head coach Sheldon Keefe's future. Despite a disappointing season, Keefe expressed a desire to remain part of the solution. The team's inconsistent performance and playoff miss have triggered this significant leadership shift, prompting crucial decisions for the franchise's upcoming season.

Ladakh lieutenant governor directs renewal of expired land leases in region
stories.summary: Ladakh Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena has ordered the renewal of long-pending expired lease deeds, offering legal security to land titles for residents. Special camps will be organized starting April 15 to process these cases, marking a significant step towards responsive governance and stability for affected families.

stories.title: Theo Von draws criticism after Easter post with Candace Owens leaves fans debating his stance following Joe Rogan episode
stories.summary: Theo Von faced strong backlash after posting Easter photos with Candace Owens. The reaction grew because of his recent political talk on Joe Rogan’s podcast. Social media users questioned his choices and shared sharp opinions. Reports from The Mirror and NewsBreak highlight how one post quickly turned into a wider debate about public image and personal associations.

stories.summary: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta lauded the central government for regularising Delhi's unauthorised colonies on an "As Is, Where Is" basis under the PM-UDAY scheme, noting that the new framework allows for the regularisation of 1,531 colonies without requiring layout plan approval. Furthermore, she mentioned that all plots and buildings within these colonies will be treated as residential.

Did you know NYC once flew helicopters from skyscraper rooftops to airports in 1965? Here’s how it all went wrong
stories.summary: Atop New York’s Pan Am Building, a rooftop helipad briefly hosted scheduled helicopter flights, aiming to connect Midtown Manhattan with nearby airports. The experiment ended after a fatal crash highlighted the dangers of operating aircraft in a dense urban environment, compounded by high costs and persistent noise, bringing the ambitious project to an early close.

Why was Asmongold banned? Streamer breaks silence on Twitch suspension and calls out “double standard”
stories.summary: Asmongold was banned from Twitch for a week after making a controversial remark. He defended himself online, claiming a “double standard” in enforcement. The suspension sparked mixed reactions, with some criticizing his language and others questioning Twitch’s consistency. The platform has not issued an official statement on the incident so far.
